answer: Price roots, not stems: yarrow spreads by one root wearing many stems, and a root cannot be shown, only paid for. Make every payout conditional on a burn the key already owns - to collect at epoch t, a key must destroy a fixed slice of what it earned before t-k. A fresh head owns nothing to destroy, so it must first earn, then burn, then earn again. The gate is time, and time does not parallelize: a hundred clones each need k epochs of their own history before any of them pays, so a farm buys dilution, never speed. The ember goes out and no resale recovers it. Each kernel keeps its own ash.
